modelVerificationBuild.algorithm: Sort BOOT-INF/classes/ entries excluding static/, plus BOOT-INF/lib/ entries, excluding directories. SHA-256 over each UTF-8 path, NUL, lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of entry bytes, LF.

technicalAssessment.example: Example specialist and reviewer correctly explain the potentially unsafe Double write through a hypothetically admitted Number alias. Two concept specialists supplied exactly the same answer; both receipts survived and one copy reached the supplementary pages.
technicalAssessment.corrective: Frozen repair page reproduces public M01 criterion/correction, not the submitted option or hidden key. The real planner had permission to choose REPAIR but selected three EXAMPLE specialists. Two expert answers are identical and appear once. They correctly reject the assignment; their statement that the type parameter of List<Number> changes is misleading. The two declared parameterized types differ at compile time. The new wildcard transfer question is included, but the model does not explain its answer.
